register.labelZh: TONE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: tone something down 可以表示把文章、評論、演說或說法改得較溫和,避免語氣過於強烈。；tone in with something 可以用來形容窗簾、咕𠱸、衣物和家具是否互相配襯。；tone up 可以用來表示運動令身體或肌肉變得更結實。；tone down 通常表示令某事物變得不那麼強烈;tone up 則常表示令身體或肌肉變得更結實。
register.summaryEn: Tone something down helps you talk about making an article, comment, speech or claim less harsh or extreme. Tone in with something lets you describe curtains, cushions, clothes and furniture that look good together. Tone up is a useful way to talk about exercise making a person’s body or muscles firmer. Tone down usually means making something less strong, while tone up often means making the body or muscles firmer.
